selected_script.angle: Maximize small spaces by replacing messy indoor draping with a compact accordion rack
selected_script.hook: Stop hanging wet clothes on chairs and doors. There is a cleaner way.

video_001_part_01.content: 0-3s: Close-up of wet laundry messy and draped over dining chairs and bedroom doors, creating a cluttered room. 3-6s: Quick solution showing the matte white accordion-style folding drying rack being smoothly expanded. 6-10s: First result cut showing laundry organized neatly on separate horizontal drying rails.

video_001_part_02.content: 10-14s: Different angle showing towels laid flat on the top platform parallel rods. 14-18s: Handheld shot folding the white rack flat and leaning it upright against the wall for storage. 18-20s: Light English text CTA on screen: Make your space cleaner and cozier.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a messy room with wet clothes draped over random furniture. 3-6s: Introduce the solid matte white tubular steel accordion laundry drying rack, expanding it on a clean laundry-room floor. 6-10s: Place damp clothing neatly over separate white rails. The product must have two X-shaped scissor side support frames, a flat top platform, and no wheels. No CTA in this segment.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-4s: Show clothes drying nicely on the flat top platform parallel rods. 4-8s: Hand folds the white accordion drying rack flat and leans it neatly against a plain wall. 8-10s: Short text overlay CTA: 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' Maintain the exact same product identity: solid matte white epoxy-coated tubular steel, white hinge caps, no wheels, and matching room lighting as the first segment.
